confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on search-result snippets from price aggregators and local guides, not on full page reads or current menus, so they are rough. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Krumlov tourist-demand context, not from live listings, and carry low confidence. Cocktail and wine are derived from the local price relationship to beer because direct local data was weak. The FX observation is the only RBA figure I could confirm (2026-03-20); it is months older than the pricing window and may not be the latest available, so refresh it before use. Overall confidence is medium, lower for accommodation, cocktail and wine.
comparable_city_reasoning: Czech regional pricing from aggregator and guide snippets (coffee about 68 CZK average, restaurant mains and goulash lunches about 200-350 CZK at non-square venues, dinner on the main square higher, Eggenberg beer about 25-30 USD-equivalent range per guide), adjusted upward for Krumlov's tourist-centre premium in July. Cocktail is set at roughly 2.7x the beer anchor and wine glass at roughly 1.6x, which is a local price-relationship assumption rather than observed data. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a high-demand historic tourist town in peak summer.
